entities.summary: John Peter Huchra was an American astronomer and professor. He was the Vice Provost for Research Policy at Harvard University and a professor of Astronomy at the Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian. He was also a former chair of the United States National Committee for the International Astronomical Union. and past president of the American Astronomical Society.
